description: Module 2 — Partner Authentication and API Security: ApiClient entity, OAuth 2.0 Client Credentials token endpoint, JWT utility, JwtAuthenticationFilter, rate limiting, unit tests
steps: Create src/main/java/com/insurance/integration/security/dto/TokenRequest.java — fields: clientId (String), clientSecret (String), grantType (String, must equal 'client_credentials'). Add @NotBlank validations
Create src/main/java/com/insurance/integration/security/dto/TokenResponse.java — fields: accessToken, tokenType ('Bearer'), expiresIn (seconds), scope

Create src/main/java/com/insurance/integration/partner/entity/ApiClient.java — JPA entity extending BaseEntity. Fields: partner (ManyToOne → Partner), clientId (VARCHAR 100 unique), clientSecretHash (VARCHAR 500), scopes (TEXT), tokenExpirySeconds (int default 3600), rateLimitPerMinute (int default 100), isActive (boolean default true), lastRotatedAt (Instant). Table: api_clients

Create src/main/java/com/insurance/integration/partner/repository/ApiClientRepository.java — JpaRepository<ApiClient, UUID>. Methods: findByClientId(String), findByClientIdAndIsActiveTrue(String), findByPartnerIdAndIsActiveTrue(UUID)
Create src/main/java/com/insurance/integration/security/dto/ApiClientRegistrationRequest.java — fields: partnerId (UUID), rateLimitPerMinute (int), tokenExpirySeconds (int), scopes (List<String>)

Create src/main/java/com/insurance/integration/security/dto/ApiClientResponse.java — fields: id, partnerId, clientId, scopes, tokenExpirySeconds, rateLimitPerMinute, isActive, createdAt. NOTE: clientSecret only returned on creation, never again

Create src/main/java/com/insurance/integration/security/service/JwtService.java — generateToken(UUID partnerId, String clientId, List<String> scopes, int expirySeconds) → String JWT. validateToken(String token) → boolean. extractPartnerId(String token) → UUID. extractScopes(String token) → List<String>. Use io.jsonwebtoken jjwt 0.12.6 (Jwts.builder(), HS256 key from app.security.jwt-secret). Key must be generated from the configured secret using Keys.hmacShaKeyFor(secret.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8))

Create src/main/java/com/insurance/integration/security/service/ApiClientService.java interface + ApiClientServiceImpl.java — registerClient(ApiClientRegistrationRequest) → returns ApiClientResponse with plain clientSecret (only time it is returned), rotateSecret(UUID clientId), deactivateClient(UUID clientId). Use BCryptPasswordEncoder to hash secrets

Create src/main/java/com/insurance/integration/security/service/AuthenticationService.java — authenticate(TokenRequest) → TokenResponse. Loads ApiClient by clientId, verifies secret with passwordEncoder.matches(), checks isActive, checks partner.isActive(), generates JWT with JwtService

Create src/main/java/com/insurance/integration/security/filter/JwtAuthenticationFilter.java — OncePerRequestFilter. Extracts Bearer token from Authorization header. Validates with JwtService. Loads partner from DB. Sets SecurityContextHolder with UsernamePasswordAuthenticationToken. Skips PUBLIC_PATHS. Add 'X-Partner-Id' to request via request wrapper or attribute for downstream use

Create src/main/java/com/insurance/integration/security/filter/RateLimitFilter.java — OncePerRequestFilter. After JWT auth, reads partner's rateLimitPerMinute from the ApiClient. Use a ConcurrentHashMap<String, RateLimitBucket> with AtomicInteger counter per partnerId + minute window. If count exceeds limit, throw new response with HTTP 429. Simple implementation — no Bucket4j needed

Create src/main/java/com/insurance/integration/security/controller/AuthController.java — @RestController @RequestMapping('/api/v1/auth'). POST /token: accepts TokenRequest (form params: grant_type, client_id, client_secret OR JSON body — support JSON). Returns TokenResponse
Update SecurityConfig: inject JwtAuthenticationFilter and RateLimitFilter beans, add them before UsernamePasswordAuthenticationFilter using addFilterBefore. Keep PUBLIC_PATHS as is
Run mvn compile and fix all errors, then run mvn test and fix all failures
acceptance_criteria: mvn compile succeeds with zero errors
POST /api/v1/auth/token with valid client_id + client_secret returns JWT Bearer token
Requests to protected endpoints without Bearer token get HTTP 401
JWT filter correctly extracts partner identity and sets SecurityContext
Rate limit filter returns HTTP 429 when per-minute limit exceeded
verification: Run: mvn compile — must show BUILD SUCCESS
Verify ApiClient entity maps to 'api_clients' table with column names matching V2 migration
Verify SecurityConfig adds JwtAuthenticationFilter to the filter chain
